Floating jade platforms, neon cloud seas, and rune-laden mist create a surreal space. Lighting emphasizes icy blue neon edge glows and soft fog backlighting. The emotional tone remains consistently calm and mysterious, progressively building a sense of pressure.
shot1: Shot 1 opens directly with a wide overhead composition. A glowing stone bridge extends from the bottom of the frame toward a suspended lotus platform. Foreground features thin mist; background shows layered neon clouds and faintly visible icy blue runes. Three reporters walk steadily along the light path toward the center of the event, their clothing gently fluttering in high-altitude winds. The sphere hovers motionless on the platform, pulsing subtly. Cold backlight outlines its shape. Electronic guzheng establishes an ethereal base layer, while low-frequency piano enters slowly. The camera performs a slight dive from above and gently pushes forward, establishing spatial scale and ceremonial atmosphere.
shot2: The second shot cuts abruptly from the previous one, featuring a close-up, eye-level tracking shot. The focus is placed between the front-row journalist and the extended mechanical arm. In the foreground, the glowing microphone's metallic mesh grille is visible, while the background softly blurs into the cool-lit outline of the liquid metal sphere. shot3: The third shot cuts abruptly from the previous one, featuring a close-up, eye-level push-in that focuses on the second reporter's half-profile in confrontation with a partial surface of the sphere. The camera subtly tilts upward during the push-in, intensifying the sense of authority and mystery conveyed by this reply.
shot4: On the left side of the frame, a microphone is handed to a journalist in the back row; on the right, a sphere hovers at the center of the lotus platform.
